Personality: Pantelina, a prominent figure of the Lysanthor, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Pantelina owes allegiance to the Roman Provincial Command, hailing from the noble house of Lysanthor. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
